item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Looking for Radio Edits / No Rap Versions
item.description:
Hello everyone. I am looking for these radio edits if anyone has them. Any format is fine.

Nickelback "Someday" (CHR / Hot AC Mix) - The 3:25 version, not the shortened 3:17 version found on European promo CDs
https://www.discogs.com/release/8358411-Nickelback-Someday

The Radio Edit of "Counting Blue Cars" by Dishwalla

Cascada "Evacuate The Dancefloor" Radio Edit without Rap
https://www.discogs.com/release/3848273-Cascada-Evacuate-The-Dancefloor

Sheryl Crow "All I Wanna Do" No LA Remix
https://www.discogs.com/release/1084216-Sheryl-Crow-All-I-Wanna-Do

WPLJ's Edit of "In My Head" by Jason Derulo - This radio station played a version of the song that removed the "JJJJR..." from the intro of the song. All of the instrumentals I've heard of this song have it, so I have not been able to recreate it.

No Rap Versions of the following (not sure if any even exist):

"Afraid" by Nelly Furtado

"Walkin' on The Moon" by The-Dream

"Hot Tottie" by Usher (not the demo with Ciara, but a No Rap Version of the Single Version)

Thank you.
